summary.zh: 转动模型，观察一个碳周围的空间方向。
summary.en: Rotate each model to inspect the arrangement around a carbon atom.

tips.zh: 109.5°、120°、180°是局部几何的理想参考值，不是所有分子的所有键角。
tips.en: 109.5°, 120° and 180° describe ideal local geometries, not every angle in every molecule.

tips.zh: 双键或三键，在判断空间方向时各算一个方向。
tips.en: A double or triple bond counts as one bonding direction when identifying local geometry.

summary.zh: 主链有几个碳，与整个分子有几个碳，是两个问题。
summary.en: Parent-chain length and total carbon count are different quantities.

tips.zh: 比较编号时，比较第一个不同的位置，不比较编号总和。
tips.en: Compare locants at the first point of difference, not the sum of locants.

tips.zh: 简单烷基支链按英文名称字母序排列，不按支链大小；di、tri不参与字母序。
tips.en: Order simple alkyl substituents by alphabetical order, not branch size; ignore di and tri in that ordering.

tips.zh: 无环饱和烷烃通式CnH2n+2；n是整个分子的碳数。
tips.en: For acyclic saturated alkanes, the formula is CnH2n+2; n counts all carbon atoms.

summary.zh: 多重键决定词尾和编号方向，环结构用cyclo。
summary.en: Multiple bonds determine suffixes and numbering; rings use cyclo.

tips.zh: 烯和炔是不饱和烃；无环单烯CnH2n、无环单炔CnH2n−2有各自适用范围。
tips.en: Alkenes and alkynes are unsaturated. CnH2n and CnH2n−2 apply to acyclic monoalkenes and monoalkynes respectively.

tips.zh: 简单单环环烷烃也满足CnH2n，不能只靠分子式把它与烯区分。
tips.en: Simple monocyclic cycloalkanes also have formula CnH2n; formula alone does not distinguish them from alkenes.

tips.zh: 二维多边形表示连接关系；环己烷不是平面正六边形，也不是苯。
tips.en: A 2D polygon shows connectivity. Cyclohexane is neither a flat regular hexagon nor benzene.

summary.zh: 切换位置异构体，对照邻、间、对与编号。
summary.en: Compare positional isomers: ortho, meta and para.

tips.zh: 邻位1,2；间位1,3；对位1,4。两个相同取代基的1,5位可改编为1,3。
tips.en: Ortho is 1,2; meta is 1,3; para is 1,4. For identical substituents, 1,5 can be renumbered 1,3.

tips.zh: 苯基C6H5—是取代基，不是芳香烃通式；横线表示连接。
tips.en: The phenyl group C6H5– is a substituent, not a general formula for arenes; the dash is an attachment bond.

tips.zh: 3D单双键画法是凯库勒示意；实际苯环的碳—碳键等价且电子离域。二维圆圈式强调离域。
tips.en: The 3D alternating bonds are a Kekulé representation. Benzene has equivalent carbon–carbon bonds and delocalized electrons; the 2D circle emphasizes this.

summary.zh: 识别卤素、羟基与醚氧，并从正确的一端编号。
summary.en: Identify halogens, hydroxyl groups and ether oxygen; number from the correct end.

tips.zh: alkyl halide是卤代烷R—X；acyl halide是酰卤R—C(=O)—X，多了羰基。
tips.en: An alkyl halide is R–X; an acyl halide is R–C(=O)–X and contains a carbonyl group.

tips.zh: 醇的羟基连在饱和碳上；醚的氧两侧连碳，且这里没有酯的羰基。
tips.en: An alcohol has hydroxyl attached to saturated carbon; an ether oxygen joins carbons without the adjacent carbonyl of an ester.

summary.zh: 看C=O旁连什么，再区分醛、酮、酸、酯、酰氯和酰胺。
summary.en: Inspect the neighbors of C=O to distinguish aldehydes, ketones, acids, esters, acyl chlorides and amides.

tips.zh: 羰基碳也计入母体碳数；甲醛、甲酸和甲酰胺都各有一个碳。
tips.en: The carbonyl carbon counts in the parent: methanal, methanoic acid and methanamide each contain one carbon.

tips.zh: 酯先分两边：英文先说醇侧烃基，再说酸侧；中文是某酸某酯。
tips.en: Split an ester into two parts. English names the alcohol-derived alkyl group before the acid-derived alkanoate; Chinese uses the opposite order.

tips.zh: 酯不是醚，酰胺不是胺；甲酸虽然羰基连氢，仍按完整羧基分类为羧酸。
tips.en: An ester is not an ether, and an amide is not an amine. Methanoic acid is classified by its complete carboxyl group, not as an aldehyde.

summary.zh: 区分氨基、酰胺与腈基，特别注意腈基里的碳。
summary.en: Distinguish amino, amide and nitrile groups, counting the nitrile carbon correctly.

tips.zh: 胺的氮不直接连羰基碳；酰胺的氮直接连羰基碳。
tips.en: An amine nitrogen is not directly attached to a carbonyl carbon; an amide nitrogen is.

tips.zh: CH3CH2CN里不仅有乙基的两个碳，还要数上CN的一个碳。
tips.en: CH3CH2CN contains two ethyl carbons plus the carbon of CN, giving three carbons in total.

text.zh: 碳连四个氢，四个方向指向四面体顶点，理想键角约109.5°。
text.en: The carbon bonds to four hydrogens toward tetrahedral corners, with an ideal angle of about 109.5 degrees.

text.zh: 只有一个碳，选用词根meth，对应中文“甲”。氢不计入碳数。
text.en: There is one carbon, so choose meth, corresponding to Chinese jia. Hydrogens do not add to the carbon count.

text.zh: 分子只有单键，属于烷烃：meth加ane，得到methane，甲烷。
text.en: Only single bonds are present. The alkane suffix ane combines with meth to give methane, or jiawan in Chinese.

prompt.zh: 甲烷中H—C—H的理想键角约是多少？
prompt.en: What is the ideal H–C–H bond angle in methane?

text.en: About 90 degrees
About 109.5 degrees
About 120 degrees
About 180 degrees

explanation.zh: 四个键方向构成四面体，理想角约109.5°，不是平面十字形。
explanation.en: Four bonding directions form a tetrahedral arrangement, about 109.5 degrees, not a flat cross.

note.zh: 这是甲烷的计算代表构象。球和棍是可视化符号，原子不是硬球。
note.en: This is a calculated representative geometry of methane. Balls and sticks are visual symbols, not literal hard atoms.

text.zh: 每个碳周围有四个成键方向，局部近似四面体；整个乙烷分子不是一个四面体。
text.en: Each carbon has four local bonding directions. Its local geometry is tetrahedral; the whole ethane molecule is not one tetrahedron.

text.zh: 主链两个碳，用eth；两个碳之间为单键，用烷烃词尾ane。
text.en: The parent chain contains two carbons, giving eth. The carbon–carbon single bond belongs to an alkane, using ane.

text.zh: C2H6叫ethane，乙烷。ethene是有双键的C2H4，不能把二者混写。
text.en: C2H6 is ethane. Ethene instead has formula C2H4 and a carbon–carbon double bond; these are different compounds.

prompt.zh: 原表把C2H6写成ethene，应改为哪个名称？
prompt.en: The worksheet calls C2H6 ethene. Which name corrects the error?

text.en: methane
ethene
ethane
ethyne

explanation.zh: 两碳、碳间单键、C2H6对应乙烷ethane。
explanation.en: Two carbons joined by a single bond, with formula C2H6, identify ethane.

note.zh: 单键可有不同扭转构象；此处为一种计算代表构象，不是固定不动的唯一形状。
note.en: Rotation about the single bond gives different conformations. This is one calculated representative, not the only frozen shape.

text.zh: 从一个末端沿连续碳链走到另一个末端，可依次经过三个碳。
text.en: Follow the continuous chain from one end to the other. It contains three carbon atoms without a branch.

text.zh: 三个碳用prop；碳之间都是单键，属于饱和烷烃，用ane。
text.en: Three carbons give the root prop. All carbon–carbon bonds are single, so the alkane suffix is ane.

title.zh: 名称不由画图角度决定
title.en: The drawing angle does not change the name

text.zh: prop加ane得到propane，丙烷。三维链弯折也仍然是同一条三碳链。
text.en: Combining prop and ane gives propane. Bending or rotating the 3D view does not change the three-carbon connectivity.

prompt.zh: 丙烷主链的词根是什么？
prompt.en: Which root describes the parent chain in propane?

text.en: meth, one carbon
eth, two carbons
prop, three carbons
but, four carbons

explanation.zh: 丙烷连续主链有三个碳，所以词根为prop。
explanation.en: Propane has three carbons in its continuous parent chain, so its root is prop.

note.zh: 模型为计算代表构象。骨架画法里的转角不等于额外的支链。
note.en: The model is a calculated representative conformer. A bend in the skeletal drawing is not an extra branch.

text.zh: 每个双键碳有三个成键方向，局部近似平面三角形，理想角约120°。
text.en: Each double-bond carbon has three bonding directions in an approximately trigonal plane, with an ideal angle near 120 degrees.

text.zh: 两个碳之间是C=C而不是单键，属于烯烃。主链两个碳，词根eth。
text.en: The two carbons are connected by C=C rather than a single bond. This is an alkene with the two-carbon root eth.

text.zh: eth加ene得到ethene，乙烯。分子式C2H4，与乙烷C2H6不同。
text.en: Combine eth with the suffix ene to obtain ethene. Its formula C2H4 distinguishes it from ethane, C2H6.

prompt.zh: 乙烯中一个双键碳的局部几何是什么？
prompt.en: What is the local geometry at a double-bond carbon in ethene?

text.en: Trigonal planar
Tetrahedral
Linear
Square planar

explanation.zh: 双键作为一个方向，加上两个C—H方向，共三个方向，近似平面三角形。
explanation.en: The double bond counts as one direction; with two C–H directions, the local geometry is trigonal planar.

note.zh: 这是计算代表结构。理想120°与模型中具体H—C—C角可能略有不同。
note.en: This is a calculated representative structure. A particular H–C–C angle may differ slightly from the ideal 120 degrees.

ene for an alkene

ol for an alcohol

explanation.zh: 识别C≡C，使用yne；乙炔是ethyne。
explanation.en: A C≡C triple bond calls for yne; the two-carbon example is ethyne.

text.en: Three carbons connect in a closed ring rather than an open propane chain. Each polygon vertex represents a carbon.

title.en: Count three carbons and single bonds

text.zh: 环上三个碳用prop；碳之间均为单键，所以使用烷烃词尾ane。
text.en: Three ring carbons give prop. Every carbon–carbon bond is single, so the ending remains ane.
The prefix cyclo denotes a ring. Adding it to propane gives cyclopropane, a three-carbon cycloalkane.

prompt.zh: 环丙烷三个碳核构成的C—C—C角约是多少？

text.en: About 60 degrees
About 109.5 degrees
About 120 degrees
About 180 degrees

note.zh: 这是计算代表结构。小环有环张力，不能把理想四面体角109.5°强加给环内角。

text.zh: 五个碳构成闭合环，每个碳在这个分子中连两个氢。
text.en: Five carbons form a closed ring. In this unsubstituted molecule each carbon is bonded to two hydrogens.

text.zh: 数环上的五个碳，得到pent，不把省略的氢或圆环中心当作碳。
text.en: Count the five ring carbons to obtain pent. Neither omitted hydrogens nor the center of the polygon is an extra carbon.

text.zh: 环用cyclo，单键烷烃用ane，组合得到cyclopentane，环戊烷。
text.en: Combine cyclo for the ring, pent for five carbons and ane for single bonds to name cyclopentane.

prompt.zh: 环戊烷碳环共有几个碳？
prompt.en: How many carbons are in the cyclopentane ring?

text.en: Three carbons
Four carbons
Five carbons
Six carbons

explanation.zh: pent代表五个碳，cyclo表示这些碳连成环。
explanation.en: Pent indicates five carbons, while cyclo indicates that the carbons form a ring.

note.zh: 这是计算代表构象。环戊烷可采用起伏构象，二维五边形仅表示连接。
note.en: This is a calculated representative conformer. Cyclopentane adopts puckered conformations; the 2D pentagon denotes connectivity only.

text.en: All carbon–carbon bonds here are single and the formula is C6H12. Benzene is aromatic and has formula C6H6.

text.zh: cyclo加hexane得到cyclohexane。转动3D模型，观察碳环并非平面。
text.en: Adding cyclo to hexane gives cyclohexane. Rotate the 3D model to see that its carbon ring is not planar.

prompt.zh: 环己烷与苯哪项不同？
prompt.en: Which difference distinguishes cyclohexane from benzene?

text.en: Cyclohexane has only five carbons

text.zh: 环己烷是C6H12且没有芳香苯环
text.en: Cyclohexane is C6H12 and has no aromatic benzene ring
They are the same molecule
Cyclohexane has no ring

explanation.zh: 六个碳不代表都是苯：环己烷是单键饱和环，苯具有离域芳香电子。
explanation.en: Six carbons do not automatically make benzene: cyclohexane is a saturated ring, while benzene has delocalized aromatic electrons.

note.zh: 模型是计算得到的代表性非平面构象。椅式等构象可以相互变化，不是平面正六边形。
note.en: This calculated representative nonplanar conformer is not a flat hexagon. Chair and other conformations can interconvert.

text.zh: 六个碳围成苯环，每个碳连一个氢，总式C6H6。
text.en: Six carbons form the benzene ring, each carrying one hydrogen, giving the molecular formula C6H6.

title.zh: 理解圆圈与单双键画法
title.en: Interpret the circle and alternating bonds

text.zh: 二维圆圈代表电子离域。3D的交替单双键是示意，实际六条碳碳键等价。
text.en: The 2D circle represents delocalization. Alternating 3D bond strokes are a representation; the six carbon–carbon bonds are equivalent.

text.zh: 没有额外取代基时，分子直接叫benzene，苯，不需要位置编号。
text.en: Without additional substituents, the molecule is named benzene directly. No positional locant is needed.

prompt.zh: 苯环内的圆圈代表什么？
prompt.en: What does the circle inside a benzene ring represent?

text.en: An extra carbon atom
An oxygen atom
A representation of delocalized electrons
Six hydrogens of cyclohexane

explanation.zh: 圆圈是苯环电子离域的简写，不是位于中心的新原子。
explanation.en: The circle is a shorthand for electron delocalization, not an additional atom at the center.

note.zh: 计算代表结构中苯环近似平面。圆圈式与凯库勒式都只是表达芳香体系的方式。
note.en: The benzene ring is approximately planar in this calculated representative structure. Circle and Kekulé drawings both represent the aromatic system.

text.zh: 先认出六个碳构成的苯环，用benzene作为这个实例的母体。
text.en: First recognize the six-carbon benzene ring, which serves as the parent in this example.

text.zh: 环外只有一个带三个氢的碳，是CH3甲基，英文methyl。
text.en: The carbon outside the ring carries three hydrogens. This CH3 substituent is a methyl group.

title.en: Omit locant 1 for a single substituent

text.zh: 只有一个甲基，所有单取代起点等价，直接写methylbenzene，甲苯。
text.en: With one methyl substituent, all starting positions are equivalent. Write methylbenzene without a locant 1.

prompt.zh: C6H5—CH3的系统英文名是什么？
prompt.en: What is the systematic English name of C6H5–CH3?

text.en: methylbenzene
ethylbenzene
cyclohexane
dimethylbenzene

explanation.zh: 苯环上连一个甲基，methyl加benzene，中文通常称甲苯。
explanation.en: One methyl group attached to benzene gives methylbenzene, commonly called toluene.

note.zh: 这是计算代表构象。苯环是六个碳，外侧甲基增加一个碳，总共有七个碳。
note.en: This is a calculated representative conformer. The six ring carbons plus one methyl carbon give seven carbons in total.

text.zh: 环上两个取代基都是CH3，因此使用di加methyl，表示二甲基。
text.en: Both ring substituents are CH3 groups, so di plus methyl describes two methyl substituents.

text.zh: 把一个甲基所连碳设为1，向邻近另一个甲基的方向编号，得到1,2。
text.en: Set one substituted carbon to 1 and number toward the adjacent methyl group, giving positions 1,2.

text.zh: 相邻的1,2位叫邻位ortho，名称为1,2-dimethylbenzene，也称o-xylene。
text.en: Adjacent 1,2 positions are called ortho. The name is 1,2-dimethylbenzene, also known as o-xylene.

prompt.zh: 两个甲基相邻，对应哪组编号？
prompt.en: Which locants describe two adjacent methyl substituents?

text.en: Ortho, 1,2
Meta, 1,3
Para, 1,4
On the same carbon, 1,1

explanation.zh: 邻位是相邻两个环碳，对应1,2。
explanation.en: Ortho substitution places the groups on adjacent ring carbons, numbered 1 and 2.

note.zh: 计算模型为邻二甲苯代表构象。甲基可转动，但相邻的连接位置不变。
note.en: This is a calculated representative conformer of o-xylene. Methyl rotation does not change the adjacent attachment positions.

title.en: Identify benzene and two methyl groups

text.zh: 六碳苯环作母体，环外两个CH3都属于甲基取代基。
text.en: The six-carbon benzene ring is the parent, and the two external CH3 groups are methyl substituents.

title.en: One ring carbon lies between them

text.zh: 两个取代碳之间沿短路径隔一个环碳，所以给出位置1,3，而不是1,2。
text.en: One ring carbon lies between the substituted carbons along the shorter path, giving locants 1,3 rather than 1,2.
The 1,3 relationship is meta. Write 1,3-dimethylbenzene, commonly called m-xylene.

prompt.zh: 间二甲苯的英文位置前缀是什么？
prompt.en: Which positional prefix describes m-xylene?

text.en: ortho
meta
para
cyclo

explanation.zh: meta表示1,3位，两个取代碳之间隔一个环碳。
explanation.en: Meta denotes 1,3 positions, with one ring carbon between the substituted carbons.

note.zh: 这是计算代表构象；它与邻、对二甲苯分子式相同，但连接位置不同。
note.en: This is a calculated representative conformer. It shares a formula with o- and p-xylene but differs in attachment positions.

text.zh: 两个CH3在苯环相对的位置，不能因为图旋转就把位置改为邻位。
text.en: The two CH3 groups occupy opposite ring positions. Rotating the drawing cannot turn them into adjacent substituents.

text.zh: 从一个取代碳开始标1，沿任意一侧到另一个取代碳，编号都会是4。
text.en: Start at one substituted carbon as 1. Numbering around either side reaches the other substituted carbon at 4.
Positions 1,4 are para, so the name is 1,4-dimethylbenzene, also called p-xylene.

prompt.en: What are the substituted-carbon locants in p-xylene?

text.en: Positions one and two
Positions one and three
Positions one and four
Both at position one

explanation.zh: 对位就是苯环相对的1,4位。
explanation.en: Para is the opposite 1,4 relationship on a benzene ring.

note.zh: 这是对二甲苯的计算代表构象。这里的1,4是连接位置，不是屏幕上下坐标。
note.en: This is a calculated representative conformer of p-xylene. The locants 1,4 describe connectivity, not screen coordinates.

title.en: Find nitro groups attached through nitrogen

text.zh: 每个硝基含一个氮和两个氧，通过氮连到苯环，不是通过氧连接。
text.en: Each nitro group contains one nitrogen and two oxygens and attaches to the benzene ring through nitrogen.

text.zh: 两个硝基所连环碳相邻，从一端设1，再把相邻位置编号2。
text.en: The two substituted ring carbons are adjacent. Assign one as 1 and the neighboring one as 2.

text.zh: di表示两个，nitro表示硝基，名称为1,2-dinitrobenzene，即邻二硝基苯。
text.en: Di means two and nitro identifies the substituent, giving 1,2-dinitrobenzene, the ortho isomer.

prompt.zh: 二硝基苯可以称为只含碳氢的烃吗？
prompt.en: Is dinitrobenzene a hydrocarbon containing only carbon and hydrogen?

text.en: Yes, every benzene derivative is a hydrocarbon
No, it also contains nitrogen and oxygen
Yes, oxygen can be ignored
No, because it contains no carbon

explanation.zh: 芳香族化合物不都属于芳香烃；二硝基苯含N、O。
explanation.en: Not every aromatic compound is an aromatic hydrocarbon; dinitrobenzene contains nitrogen and oxygen.

note.zh: 这是计算代表构象。硝基显示一种N正、O负的共振式；不能据图认为两条N—O键永远不同。
note.en: This is a calculated representative conformer. Nitro is drawn in one charge-separated resonance form; the N–O bonds should not be viewed as permanently localized.

text.zh: 苯环上有两个NO2取代基，均通过氮原子连接，使用dinitro前缀。
text.en: Two NO2 substituents attach through nitrogen atoms to the benzene ring, requiring the prefix dinitro.

text.zh: 两个取代位置之间隔一个环碳，最小编号是1,3，不写较大的1,5。
text.en: One ring carbon separates the attachment sites. Choose the lower locants 1,3 rather than the alternative 1,5.
The locants 1,3 correspond to meta substitution, giving the full name 1,3-dinitrobenzene.

prompt.zh: 为什么选1,3而不选1,5？
prompt.en: Why choose 1,3 rather than 1,5 for these identical groups?

text.en: Because carbon five does not exist
Because nitro can attach only at position three

text.zh: 反向编号得到较小位置数
text.en: Reversing the numbering gives lower locants
Because the molecule has only three carbons

explanation.zh: 相同两个取代基可以选择编号方向，使位置数为较小的1,3。
explanation.en: For two identical substituents, choose the numbering direction that produces the smaller locants 1,3.

note.zh: 这是间二硝基苯计算代表构象。分子含氮氧，不应归为只含碳氢的烃。
note.en: This is a calculated representative conformer of m-dinitrobenzene. Its nitrogen and oxygen atoms exclude it from the hydrocarbon class.

text.zh: 六个环碳仍作为benzene母体，外面的两个氮氧基团是硝基。
text.en: The six ring carbons form the benzene parent; the two external nitrogen–oxygen groups are nitro substituents.

text.zh: 一个取代碳编号1，对面的取代碳编号4，属于对位排列。
text.en: Assign one substituted carbon locant 1 and the opposite carbon locant 4, identifying the para relationship.

text.zh: 两个硝基用dinitro，接benzene，得到1,4-dinitrobenzene，也称对二硝基苯。
text.en: Two nitro groups use dinitro before benzene, giving 1,4-dinitrobenzene, the para isomer.

prompt.zh: para表示哪个位置关系？
prompt.en: Which positional relationship does para mean?

text.en: Adjacent positions 1,2
Positions 1,3 with one carbon between
Opposite positions 1,4
On the same carbon

explanation.zh: 对位para就是苯环上相对的1,4位。
explanation.en: Para denotes opposite 1,4 positions on the benzene ring.

note.zh: 这是计算代表构象；硝基转动并不改变苯环上的1,4位置关系。
note.en: This is a calculated representative conformer. Rotation of a nitro group does not change the 1,4 ring-substitution pattern.

text.zh: 只数碳得到两个碳，母体为ethane；氯不算进碳数。
text.en: Counting carbon atoms gives two, so the parent is ethane. The chlorine atom is not counted as a carbon.

text.zh: 一个氯代替了乙烷中的一个氢，卤素氯作为取代基写chloro。
text.en: One chlorine replaces a hydrogen of ethane. The chlorine substituent is named using the prefix chloro.

text.zh: chloro加ethane得到氯乙烷。乙烷两端等价，不必额外写1。
text.en: Combine chloro with ethane to give chloroethane. The two ends of ethane are equivalent, so locant 1 is unnecessary.

prompt.zh: 氯作为取代基使用哪个英文前缀？
prompt.en: Which prefix names a chlorine substituent?

text.en: fluoro
chloro
bromo
iodo

explanation.zh: Cl对应chloro；F、Br、I分别为fluoro、bromo、iodo。
explanation.en: Cl uses chloro; F, Br and I use fluoro, bromo and iodo respectively.

note.zh: 这是计算代表构象。氯连饱和碳，属于卤代烷，不是含C=O的酰氯。
note.en: This calculated representative conformer has chlorine on saturated carbon, making it a haloalkane rather than an acyl chloride.

text.zh: 碳链两个碳，且碳间为单键，母体名称为ethane。
text.en: The carbon chain has two carbons joined by a single bond, so its parent name is ethane.

text.zh: I是碘的元素符号，不是数字1；作为取代基用iodo前缀。
text.en: I is the element symbol for iodine, not the number 1. As a substituent it uses the prefix iodo.

text.zh: iodo写在ethane前面，得到iodoethane，中文是碘乙烷。
text.en: Place iodo before ethane to produce iodoethane, the two-carbon haloalkane containing iodine.

prompt.zh: 结构式末尾的I表示什么？
prompt.en: What does the final I in the structure mean?

text.en: The first carbon
A chlorine atom
An iodine atom
One hydrogen atom

explanation.zh: I是iodine碘，前缀iodo；位置编号才使用阿拉伯数字。
explanation.en: I means iodine, named with iodo. Numerical locants use Arabic numerals instead.

note.zh: 该计算代表构象用元素颜色帮助识别，球的大小也只是显示约定。
note.en: The calculated representative conformer uses element colors for recognition; displayed sphere sizes are visualization conventions.

text.zh: 连续碳链含三个碳，采用丙烷propane作为母体。
text.en: The continuous chain contains three carbon atoms, so select propane as the parent name.

title.en: Locate chlorine on the middle carbon

text.zh: 从任意一端编号，中间碳都是2号，氯直接连在2号碳上。
text.en: Numbering from either end makes the middle carbon number 2, and chlorine is attached directly to that carbon.

title.en: Add the locant and halo prefix

text.zh: 2表示氯的位置，chloro是氯代前缀，合成2-chloropropane。
text.en: The locant 2 specifies the chlorine position, followed by chloro and propane: 2-chloropropane.

prompt.zh: 名称里的2指的是什么？
prompt.en: What does the 2 in 2-chloropropane mean?

text.en: There are two chlorine atoms
Chlorine is attached to carbon two
The parent has only two carbons
There is a carbon–carbon double bond

explanation.zh: 数字是位置编号。两个氯需要dichloro，而本例只有一个氯。
explanation.en: The number is a locant. Two chlorines would require dichloro; this molecule contains only one chlorine.

note.zh: 这是计算代表构象。中间碳还带一个氢，与两个末端甲基和氯共形成四个键。
note.en: In this calculated representative conformer the middle carbon also bears a hydrogen, completing four bonds with two methyl groups and chlorine.

text.zh: 主链为三个碳，羟基连在其中一个碳上，选择propan和ol。
text.en: The parent has three carbons with hydroxyl attached to one of them, so the name uses propan and ol.

title.en: OH is on the middle carbon

text.zh: 从任意一端数，中间碳都是2号，羟基的位置必须标为2。
text.en: Counting from either end gives the middle carbon locant 2, so the hydroxyl position must be marked 2.

text.zh: 名称是propan-2-ol，与propan-1-ol分子式相同，但羟基位置不同。
text.en: The name is propan-2-ol. It has the same formula as propan-1-ol but a different hydroxyl attachment position.

prompt.zh: 2-丙醇中的2表示有两个羟基吗？
prompt.en: Does the 2 in propan-2-ol mean two hydroxyl groups?

text.en: Yes, it means two OH groups

text.zh: 否，表示第二个碳的位置
text.en: No, it gives the carbon-two position
No, it means only two carbons
Yes, it means two oxygen atoms

explanation.zh: 2是位置编号；本例只有一个OH。多个羟基会使用diol等词尾。
explanation.en: The 2 is a locant. This example has one OH; multiple hydroxyl groups would use endings such as diol.

note.zh: 这是计算代表构象。两个末端CH3相同，羟基碳不是手性中心。
note.en: This is a calculated representative conformer. The two terminal CH3 groups are identical, so the hydroxyl-bearing carbon is not stereogenic.

text.zh: 氧连接两侧甲基，没有O—H，也没有相邻羰基，因此是醚。
text.en: Oxygen connects two methyl groups with no O–H bond and no adjacent carbonyl, identifying an ether.

text.zh: 把一侧CH3和氧看作methoxy甲氧基，另一侧碳作为methane母体。
text.en: Treat one CH3 plus oxygen as the methoxy group, and use the carbon on the other side as the methane parent.

title.zh: 两个名称对应同一结构
title.en: Two names identify the same structure

text.zh: 系统名methoxymethane是甲氧基甲烷；常用名dimethyl ether是二甲醚。
text.en: The systematic name is methoxymethane. The common functional-class name dimethyl ether describes the same structure.

prompt.zh: 二甲醚为什么不是乙醇？
prompt.en: Why is dimethyl ether not ethanol?

text.en: Dimethyl ether has no carbon
Their molecular formulas are different
Dimethyl ether has C–O–C and no O–H bond
Dimethyl ether has a carbonyl group

explanation.zh: 同分子式不等于同连接结构，醚氧不带氢，而乙醇有羟基。
explanation.en: Equal formulas do not imply equal connectivity. The ether oxygen has no hydrogen, while ethanol has hydroxyl.

note.zh: 这是计算代表构象。系统命名选择甲烷母体，不是把氧跨过去连成乙烷主链。
note.en: This is a calculated representative conformer. The systematic parent is methane; the chain must not jump across oxygen to invent ethane.

title.en: Compare the carbon groups on each side

text.zh: 氧一侧是一个碳的甲基，另一侧是两个碳的乙基，总碳数为三个。
text.en: One side of oxygen is a one-carbon methyl group and the other is a two-carbon ethyl group, giving three carbons in total.

title.en: Choose ethane as the larger parent

text.zh: 本例较长的两碳部分作ethane母体，一碳加氧的部分作methoxy甲氧基。
text.en: Use the longer two-carbon part as the ethane parent, and name the one-carbon part plus oxygen methoxy.

text.zh: methoxy放在ethane前，得到methoxyethane，甲氧基乙烷，而不是丙醇。
text.en: Place methoxy before ethane to obtain methoxyethane, an ether rather than a propanol.

prompt.zh: 甲氧基乙烷的命名母体有几个碳？
prompt.en: How many carbons are in the naming parent of methoxyethane?

text.en: One carbon
Two carbons
Three carbons
Four carbons

explanation.zh: 母体ethane含两个碳；methoxy中的另一个碳属于取代基。
explanation.en: The ethane parent has two carbons. The remaining carbon belongs to the methoxy substituent.

note.zh: 这是计算代表构象。全分子三个碳，但醚的烷氧基命名不能把氧当成碳链的一环。
note.en: This is a calculated representative conformer. It has three carbons overall, but alkoxyalkane naming does not count oxygen as part of a carbon chain.

title.en: Identify a carbonyl attached to hydrogen

text.zh: 碳与氧形成双键，羰基碳两边在这个特例中都是氢，因此为最简单的醛。
text.en: Carbon forms a double bond to oxygen and is attached to hydrogen on both remaining sides, making the simplest aldehyde.

text.zh: 虽然没有CH3，分子仍有羰基里的一个碳，词根为meth。
text.en: Even without a CH3 group, the carbonyl supplies one carbon atom, so the correct root is meth.

text.zh: methane去e加al得到methanal，甲醛；不是methanol甲醇。
text.en: Replace the final e of methane with al to obtain methanal, not the alcohol methanol.

prompt.zh: 甲醛的母体碳数是多少？
prompt.en: How many parent carbons does methanal contain?

text.en: Zero carbons
One carbon
Two carbons
Three carbons

explanation.zh: 羰基C=O中的C必须计入，甲醛总共有一个碳。
explanation.en: The carbon of C=O must be counted; methanal contains one carbon atom.

note.zh: 这是计算代表结构。甲醛中的al与甲醇中的ol只差一个字母，却是不同官能团。
note.en: This is a calculated representative structure. The endings al and ol differ by one letter but name different functional groups.

text.zh: 末端碳连氧双键，并直接连一个氢；这个CHO是醛基。
text.en: The terminal carbon is double-bonded to oxygen and directly bonded to hydrogen; this CHO group identifies an aldehyde.

title.en: Count the CH3 and CHO carbons

text.zh: 甲基里一个碳，加醛基里一个碳，总共两个碳，用eth。醛基碳编号1。
text.en: One methyl carbon plus one aldehyde carbon gives two carbons and the root eth. The aldehyde carbon is carbon 1.

text.zh: eth加醛的词尾al组成ethanal；不能漏掉醛基碳而称methanal。
text.en: The eth root with the aldehyde ending al gives ethanal. Omitting the aldehyde carbon would incorrectly give methanal.

prompt.zh: CH3CHO中有几个碳？
prompt.en: How many carbons are in CH3CHO?

text.en: One, counting only CH3
Two, including the CHO carbon
Three, counting oxygen as one
Four, treating the 3 as a carbon count

explanation.zh: CH3的3是氢数，不是碳数；CH3和CHO各有一个碳。
explanation.en: The 3 in CH3 counts hydrogens, not carbons. CH3 and CHO each contain one carbon.

note.zh: 这是计算代表构象。醛基碳附近近似平面，但整个分子不因此只有一种空间构象。

text.zh: 羰基碳两侧都连甲基碳，没有直接连氢，因此该官能团是酮。
text.en: The carbonyl carbon is bonded to methyl carbons on both sides and not directly to hydrogen, identifying a ketone.

title.en: Include carbonyl in the three-carbon chain

text.zh: 左甲基、羰基、右甲基共三个碳，羰基在2号碳，母体为propan。
text.en: The left methyl, carbonyl and right methyl supply three carbons; the carbonyl is carbon 2 in the propan parent.

text.zh: 使用one得到propanone，丙酮。三碳酮的羰基只能在中间，常省略2。
text.en: The ketone suffix one gives propanone. A three-carbon ketone can only have the carbonyl in the middle, so 2 is commonly omitted.

prompt.zh: 丙酮为什么不是醛？
prompt.en: Why is propanone a ketone rather than an aldehyde?

text.en: Because it has no oxygen
Because it has no carbon–oxygen double bond

text.zh: 因为羰基碳两侧都连碳
text.en: Because its carbonyl carbon is bonded to carbon on both sides
Because it contains no hydrogens

explanation.zh: 区分醛酮看羰基碳的连接：丙酮的羰基碳连两个碳。
explanation.en: Inspect the carbonyl carbon: in propanone it is bonded to two carbon atoms, the defining ketone pattern.

note.zh: 这是计算代表构象。CO简写在此表示C(=O)，并不是C—O单键。
note.en: This is a calculated representative conformer. CO in this condensed formula means C(=O), not a C–O single bond.

text.zh: 同一个碳连氧双键和OH，这一整体是羧基，不能拆开误叫醛或醇。
text.en: One carbon bears both a double-bonded oxygen and OH. This complete carboxyl group must not be misclassified as an aldehyde or alcohol.

text.zh: 甲酸没有额外的烷基碳，但羧基里有一个碳，所以碳根为meth。
text.en: Methanoic acid has no additional alkyl carbon, but its carboxyl group contains one carbon, giving meth.

title.en: Use oic acid for the carboxylic acid

text.zh: 一碳的羧酸写methanoic acid，中文甲酸，常用英文名formic acid。
text.en: The one-carbon carboxylic acid is methanoic acid, commonly called formic acid, using the ending oic acid.

prompt.zh: 甲酸应按哪个完整官能团分类？
prompt.en: Which complete functional group determines the class of methanoic acid?

text.en: Carboxyl group COOH
Ether group C–O–C
Amino group NH2
Nitrile group C≡N

explanation.zh: 羰基碳连OH构成完整羧基，所以甲酸属于羧酸。
explanation.en: OH attached to the carbonyl carbon forms a carboxyl group, so methanoic acid is a carboxylic acid.

note.zh: 这是计算代表结构。甲酸羰基碳虽连氢，也不能把完整羧基忽略而称作醛。
note.en: This is a calculated representative structure. Although its carbonyl carbon also bears hydrogen, the complete carboxyl group makes it an acid, not an aldehyde.

text.en: The two-carbon root eth and acid ending oic acid give ethanoic acid, commonly known as acetic acid.

text.zh: 羰基碳连一个单键氧，该氧再连碳，构成C(=O)—O—C酯连接。
text.en: The carbonyl carbon bonds to a single-bond oxygen that then joins carbon, giving the ester pattern C(=O)–O–C.

text.zh: 酸侧CH3—C(=O)共有两个碳，对应乙酸来源的ethanoate。
text.en: The acid-derived CH3–C(=O) part contains two carbons, giving ethanoate from ethanoic acid.

text.zh: 单键氧后只有一个CH3碳，因此醇侧烃基为methyl，不是ethyl。
text.en: After the single-bond oxygen there is only one CH3 carbon, so the alcohol-derived alkyl group is methyl, not ethyl.

text.zh: 英文先甲基methyl、后ethanoate，得methyl ethanoate；中文乙酸甲酯。
text.en: English places methyl first and ethanoate second: methyl ethanoate. Chinese names the acid part before the alcohol-derived group.

prompt.zh: CH3COOCH3应叫什么？
prompt.en: What is the correct name for CH3COOCH3?

text.en: ethyl ethanoate
ethyl methanoate
methyl ethanoate
pentyl ethanoate

explanation.zh: 酸侧两个碳是乙酸，氧后一个碳是甲基，所以是乙酸甲酯。
explanation.en: Two acid-side carbons give ethanoate, and one carbon after oxygen gives methyl: methyl ethanoate.

note.zh: 纠正原表：乙酸甲酯是CH3COOCH3；若氧后写CH2CH3，就是乙酸乙酯，不能仍标甲酯。
note.en: Worksheet correction: methyl ethanoate is CH3COOCH3. If the oxygen is followed by CH2CH3, the compound is ethyl ethanoate, not methyl ethanoate.

text.zh: 先找C(=O)—O—C，按羰基碳与单键氧的连接，把分子分为两侧。
text.en: First locate C(=O)–O–C, then use the carbonyl carbon–oxygen connection to distinguish the two naming parts.

text.zh: 酸侧CH3加羰基碳，共两个碳，因此酸来源是乙酸，命名片段ethanoate。
text.en: The acid side includes CH3 and the carbonyl carbon, two carbons altogether, giving the ethanoic-acid-derived name ethanoate.

title.en: Two carbons after oxygen give ethyl

text.zh: 单键氧后是CH2CH3，有两个碳，是ethyl乙基，不是methyl甲基。
text.en: The single-bond oxygen is followed by CH2CH3, a two-carbon ethyl group rather than a one-carbon methyl group.

text.zh: 英文ethyl ethanoate先说乙基、再说乙酸来源；中文为乙酸乙酯。
text.en: The English name ethyl ethanoate states the alkyl part first and the acid-derived part second.

prompt.zh: 乙酸乙酯中，氧后烃基有几个碳？
prompt.en: How many carbons are in the alkyl group after oxygen in ethyl ethanoate?

text.en: One carbon, methyl
Two carbons, ethyl
Three carbons, propyl
Four carbons, butyl

explanation.zh: O—CH2—CH3中氧后有两个碳，所以醇侧叫ethyl。
explanation.en: O–CH2–CH3 has two carbons after oxygen, identifying the alcohol-derived group as ethyl.

note.zh: 这是计算代表构象，也是原讲义酯行所画CH3COOCH2CH3的正确名称。
note.en: This is a calculated representative conformer and the correct name for the CH3COOCH2CH3 structure drawn in the worksheet ester row.

title.en: Split the structure at the ester linkage

text.zh: H—C(=O)—O—CH2CH3含酯基，不要把最左边的氢误当成碳。
text.en: H–C(=O)–O–CH2CH3 contains an ester. The leftmost H is hydrogen and must not be counted as carbon.

text.zh: H—C(=O)只有羰基这一个碳，酸来源为甲酸，名称片段methanoate。
text.en: H–C(=O) contains only the carbonyl carbon, so the acid part comes from methanoic acid and is named methanoate.

text.zh: 氧后CH2CH3共有两个碳，醇侧烃基为ethyl乙基。
text.en: The CH2CH3 group after oxygen contains two carbons, making the alcohol-derived alkyl name ethyl.

text.zh: 先ethyl后methanoate，得ethyl methanoate；中文反过来表达，叫甲酸乙酯。
text.en: Put ethyl before methanoate to form ethyl methanoate. The Chinese name expresses the acid part first.

prompt.zh: 甲酸乙酯的酸侧有几个碳？
prompt.en: How many carbons are in the acid-derived part of ethyl methanoate?

text.en: One carbon
Two carbons
Three carbons
No carbons

explanation.zh: 甲酸侧只有H—C(=O)中的一个碳，另两个碳在乙基侧。
explanation.en: The methanoic-acid-derived side has one carbon in H–C(=O); the other two carbons belong to ethyl.

note.zh: 这是计算代表构象。甲酸乙酯与乙酸甲酯同为C3H6O2，但酸侧与醇侧碳分配不同。
note.en: This calculated representative conformer has the same formula C3H6O2 as methyl ethanoate, but different carbon allocation and connectivity.

title.zh: 不要直接把七碳当酸母体
title.en: Do not use all seven carbons as the acid parent

text.zh: 分子总共七个碳，但酯要按酸侧、醇侧分别命名，不能简单叫庚酸酯。
text.en: There are seven carbons in total, but ester naming separates acid and alcohol parts; it is not simply a heptanoate.

title.en: The acid side is still ethanoic acid

text.zh: CH3—C(=O)两个碳组成酸侧，用ethanoate，碳链再长也不改变这两碳。
text.en: The acid side is the two-carbon CH3–C(=O) fragment, giving ethanoate regardless of the longer chain on the other side.

title.en: Expand the parentheses to count pentyl

text.zh: 氧后CH2(CH2)3CH3的碳数为1+3+1=5，所以是pentyl戊基。
text.en: After oxygen, CH2(CH2)3CH3 contains 1 + 3 + 1 = 5 carbons, so the alkyl group is pentyl.

text.zh: 英文先写pentyl再写ethanoate，中文为乙酸戊酯，指定这里是直链正戊基。
text.en: Write pentyl followed by ethanoate. The pentyl group shown here is the straight-chain pentan-1-yl group.

prompt.zh: 氧后CH2(CH2)3CH3含几个碳？
prompt.en: How many carbons are in CH2(CH2)3CH3 after oxygen?

text.en: Three carbons
Four carbons
Five carbons
Seven carbons

explanation.zh: 前面CH2一个碳，括号(CH2)3三个碳，末端CH3一个碳，总共五个。
explanation.en: The first CH2 supplies one carbon, (CH2)3 supplies three, and the terminal CH3 supplies one: five altogether.

note.zh: 这是直链乙酸戊酯的计算代表构象。长链可以扭转，不能根据某个弯曲视角误判为支链。
note.en: This is a calculated representative conformer of straight-chain pentyl ethanoate. Chain torsion does not turn it into a branched ester.

text.en: Follow ethanoyl with chloride to obtain ethanoyl chloride, the acyl chloride derived from ethanoic acid.

Ethanoyl chloride has no carbon
They are identical
Chloroethane contains two oxygens

Whether the sphere is blue
Whether the drawing is horizontal

text.zh: 羰基碳直接连接NH2的氮，C(=O)NH2是酰胺基团。
text.en: The carbonyl carbon directly bonds to the nitrogen of NH2; C(=O)NH2 is the amide functional group.

text.zh: CH3一个碳、C=O一个碳，共两个碳，酰胺母体采用ethan。
text.en: One CH3 carbon and one C=O carbon give two parent carbons, so the amide name starts with ethan.

text.zh: 两碳母体配amide词尾得到ethanamide，中文乙酰胺。
text.en: Combine the two-carbon parent ethan with the amide suffix to obtain ethanamide, also called acetamide.

prompt.zh: CH3CONH2的正确名称是哪一个？
prompt.en: Which name matches CH3CONH2?

text.en: ethanamine
methanamide
ethanamide
ethanol

explanation.zh: 这里有羰基和与其相连的氮，且共两个碳，因此是乙酰胺。
explanation.en: The structure has nitrogen attached to a carbonyl and contains two carbons, identifying ethanamide.

note.zh: 这是计算代表构象。本例氮连两个氢，其他酰胺也可在氮上有烃基取代。
note.en: This is a calculated representative conformer. Here nitrogen bears two hydrogens; other amides may have N-alkyl substituents.

text.zh: NH2直接连饱和碳，附近没有C=O相连，因此属于胺，不是酰胺。
text.en: NH2 attaches to saturated carbon without an adjacent C=O bond, making this an amine rather than an amide.

text.zh: 主链两个碳用ethan，氨基所连碳为1号，两端等价时不必重复标1。
text.en: The two-carbon chain gives ethan, with the amino-bearing carbon assigned number 1; the single distinct position need not be repeated.

text.zh: 系统名ethanamine采用amine词尾；常用名ethylamine是乙基加胺，均指乙胺。
text.en: The systematic name ethanamine uses the suffix amine. The common name ethylamine combines ethyl and amine for the same molecule.

prompt.zh: 乙胺与乙酰胺的区别是什么？
prompt.en: What distinguishes ethanamine from ethanamide?

text.zh: 乙胺的氮不直接连羰基碳
text.en: Its nitrogen is not directly attached to carbonyl carbon
Ethanamine contains no nitrogen
Ethanamine has one additional oxygen

text.zh: 二者只是不同英文拼写
text.en: They are merely alternative English spellings

explanation.zh: 乙胺为CH3CH2NH2，没有羰基；乙酰胺为CH3C(=O)NH2。
explanation.en: Ethanamine is CH3CH2NH2 without a carbonyl, whereas ethanamide is CH3C(=O)NH2.

note.zh: 这是计算代表构象。普通胺氮近似三角锥，氮的孤对电子未以原子球表示。
note.en: This is a calculated representative conformer. Ordinary amine nitrogen is approximately pyramidal; its lone pair is not shown as an atom sphere.

text.zh: 三键的一端是氮N，因此属于腈基，而不是碳碳三键的炔烃。
text.en: One end of the triple bond is nitrogen, so this is a nitrile group rather than the C≡C group of an alkyne.

text.zh: 乙基部分两个碳，加腈基中的一个碳，共三个碳；腈基碳编号1。
text.en: The two ethyl carbons plus the nitrile carbon make three parent carbons. The nitrile carbon receives locant 1.

title.en: Add nitrile to the parent name

text.zh: 三碳母体为propane，加nitrile得到propanenitrile，丙腈，不是乙腈。
text.en: The three-carbon parent propane takes the ending nitrile to give propanenitrile, not the two-carbon ethanenitrile.

prompt.zh: CH3CH2CN为什么叫丙腈而不是乙腈？
prompt.en: Why is CH3CH2CN propanenitrile rather than ethanenitrile?

text.en: Nitrogen counts as a carbon
The carbon in CN is included in the parent chain
A triple bond represents three carbons
All nitriles are called propanenitrile

explanation.zh: CH3、CH2和CN各贡献一个碳，总共三个碳，编号从腈基碳开始。
explanation.en: CH3, CH2 and CN each contribute one carbon, giving three in total, numbered from the nitrile carbon.

note.zh: 这是计算代表构象。腈基碳与氮附近近似直线；氮原子不计入碳数。
note.en: This is a calculated representative conformer. The nitrile carbon–nitrogen region is linear, and nitrogen is not counted as carbon.
